# ComplaintCheck

ComplaintCheck lets you search and monitor financial companies using live CFPB complaint data.

**Core value:** See a company’s complaint history before you sign up.

## Site Structure
- / — Home with search input, result summary (12-month count, all-time, top 3 issues, trend), link to official CFPB listing.
- /dashboard — Watchlist, per-company trend chart, issue breakdown, last checked date, alert feed. Requires Supabase Auth.
- /pricing — Free vs Pro tiers: $9.99/mo or $89/yr for unlimited watchlist, spike alerts, CSV export, side-by-side comparison.
- /about — What this is, data source (CFPB Consumer Complaint Database), disclaimer.

## Key Links
- Search example: https://complaintcheck.app/
- Pricing: https://complaintcheck.app/pricing
- About: https://complaintcheck.app/about
- Contact: mailto:contact@calyvent.com?subject=ComplaintCheck%20Inquiry

## Data Source
Live data pulled directly from the CFPB's official Consumer Complaint Database via public API. No manual entry.
